blocks.source: Vol III, Conclusion, § Safety Cases Built on Evidence
blocks.md: An incident record links an approved configuration change to an observed service outcome, but the link does not imply general correctness. The engineer must still establish which claims the record supports, which enforcement mechanisms make those claims trustworthy, and which failure modes remain unaddressed. That work takes the form of an empirical *safety case*: an inspectable, structured argument that specific claims hold within a defined operating envelope, not a certificate that the agent behaves correctly under all reachable conditions.
